[SWS_CM_80505] Data accumulation for UDP data transmission ( Signal-Based Static network binding)
⌈
To allow for the transmission of multi-
ple messages (signal-based events and signal-based field notifiers) within a single
UDP datagram, data accumulation for UDP data transmission shall be supported.
